claim: Canonical comparison from genuine direct-image sheaf cohomology to genuine source cohomology, natural in source coefficients, bijective in degree zero and injective in degree one; actual H1 pullbacks for all five original completed quotient maps inject into the same original source H1.

obligations.name: Original cohomology carriers
obligations.required: Use actual Ext-derived cohomology on the source and target sites, not differential duals or redefined source groups.
obligations.constructed: SourceCohomologyComparison318 uses Sheaf.H on the original opens sites; SchemeSourceCohomology318 specializes the exact original additive structure sheaves.
obligations.justification: The predecessor supplies the actual sheaf condition and pushed_eq; HasExt and enough injectives come from pinned Grothendieck-abelian sheaf instances. ActualSourceHOnePullbacks318.SourceHOne is H1 of the original ContactGlobalSmooth318.Model units.

obligations.name: Inverse-image exactness
obligations.required: The functor used on Ext must be additive and preserve finite limits and colimits.
obligations.constructed: inverseImage is the original site sheafPullback along inverse images of opens.
obligations.justification: Finite-limit preservation is the pinned representably-flat site theorem for Opens.map; colimit preservation comes from the actual inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. Additivity follows from finite products in abelian categories, not an extra target theorem assumption.

obligations.name: Original constant integer sheaf
obligations.required: Identify the pulled-back constant sheaf used as Ext first argument with the original source constant integer sheaf.
obligations.constructed: inverseImageConstantIso is the unique left-adjoint comparison of the composite constant-sheaf/inverse-image adjunction with the original source constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction.
obligations.justification: directImageGlobalSections is definitionally the source global-sections functor. integerIso is its component at the original ULift integer additive group. No dimension, choice of basis, or arbitrary identification is introduced.

obligations.name: Canonical comparison and direction
obligations.required: Construct Hn(Y,f_*F) to Hn(X,F) with correct variance and actual adjunction maps.
obligations.constructed: comparison applies exact inverse image to Ext, postcomposes with the actual adjunction counit, then precomposes with integerIso.inv.
obligations.justification: comparison_apply records the exact composition. comparison_naturality proves compatibility with every actual source-sheaf morphism. comparison_mkZero identifies degree zero with the actual inverse adjunction and original integer-sheaf comparison; degree-zero bijectivity follows without direct-image exactness.

obligations.name: Degree-one injectivity without a false exactness premise
obligations.required: Derive Ext1(A,RB) injection into Ext1(LA,B) when L is exact, R is left exact and D has enough injectives.
obligations.constructed: mate_one_injective embeds B into an actual chosen injective object, forms the source cokernel and the cokernel after R, and uses the monomorphism from the latter into R of the original cokernel.
obligations.justification: R preserves the chosen injective object by the exact-left-adjoint theorem. Long exact Ext sequences express each class as a connecting class. Naturality for the actual mapped short exact sequence and adjunction carries a zero mate to a lift; the cokernel monomorphism cancels, giving a lift of the original degree-zero class and hence zero original Ext1 class. R is never assumed to preserve cokernels.

obligations.name: Actual site specialization
obligations.required: Discharge every generic adjunction and injective hypothesis on the actual source and target sheaf categories.
obligations.constructed: SourceCohomologyComparison318.comparison_one_injective composes the generic mate injection with precomposition by the verified integer-sheaf isomorphism.
obligations.justification: The actual inverse image is exact, the actual direct image is a right adjoint and left exact/additive, and the actual source category has enough injectives. No unproved affine/finite-map acyclicity premise occurs.

obligations.name: Actual scheme pullback and predecessor trace
obligations.required: Retain the exact original O_Y to f_*O_X map, rather than substituting an arbitrary injection into the source.
obligations.constructed: SchemeSourceCohomology318.pullback is comparison after the predecessor actual sheaf-cohomology pullback.
obligations.justification: Its factorization is exact. The original all-open trace/8 sheaf retraction gives predecessor H1 injectivity, and comparison_one_injective gives injectivity into source H1 itself. All five predecessor sources are copied byte-for-byte with producer receipt bound.

obligations.name: Full five-map coverage and common-source consumer
obligations.required: Specialize every complementary quotient and the fifth quotient on the whole original completed curves.
obligations.constructed: ActualSourceHOnePullbacks318 has characterPullback for every Fin4 and fifthPullback for the exact original fifth completed map, all targeting the same SourceHOne.
obligations.justification: The original maps already cover finite and infinity charts and branch points; no additional affine/nonempty restriction appears. character_injective and fifth_injective are the actual downstream endpoints, and factorization lemmas bind them to the predecessor maps.

obligations.name: Surjectivity, duality and historical scope boundary
obligations.required: Do not promote degree-one injection to comparison isomorphism or Jacobian duality without additional input.
obligations.constructed: This packet gives the canonical map and injection, not H1 comparison surjectivity or a common-source fivefold decomposition.
obligations.justification: Finite/affine direct image exactness for quasi-coherent modules does not by itself establish exactness in the all-additive-sheaves category used here. Bounded search found real Ext/sheaf-cohomology support but no affine quasi-coherent vanishing or Picard-tangent/Serre-duality comparison. Full comparison bijectivity, rational H1 module structure, fivefold H1 spanning, representability and Jacobian/isogeny remain open. This is a new connecting argument, not a claim that no historical justification exists.
